description: Citizens Financial Group, Inc. is headquartered in Providence, Rhode Island, and offers a broad range of retail and commercial banking products and services to individuals, small businesses, middle-market companies, large corporations and institutions, offered through more than 1,000 branches in 14 states and the District of Columbia and 75 retail and commercial non-branch offices, though certain lines of business serve national markets. At December 31, 2025 it had total assets of $226.4 billion, total deposits of $183.3 billion and total stockholders' equity of $26.3 billion, plus total client assets of $61.9 billion including assets under management of $35.9 billion and transactional assets of $26.0 billion. It is a bank holding company incorporated under Delaware state law in 1984 whose primary federal regulator is the Federal Reserve Board.
